dossier.purpose: rtk (Rust Token Killer) is a single-binary Rust CLI proxy (Cargo.toml:1-10; README.md:43). Agent hooks or plugins rewrite shell commands such as `git status` to `rtk git status`; rtk runs the real command, compresses its output with built-in Rust filters, TOML filters and a never-worse guard (src/core/guard.rs:16-23), and prints the compact result (README.md:151). It logs raw-vs-filtered size per command in a local SQLite DB (`rtk gain`), keeps unfiltered output for failures and truncations in a content-addressed recall store (`rtk recall <hash>`), and reaches provider spend only by shelling out to the external `ccusage` CLI for Claude Code (`rtk cc-economics`). Answer to the provider-usage question: within this project no single tool measures provider usage from both Claude Code and Codex logs. rtk's own savings numbers are bytes/4 estimates of bash output; the only input/output/cache-creation/cache-read token figures come from the external ccusage tool, wired for Claude Code only (src/analytics/ccusage.rs:1-30; src/main.rs:507); rtk's own transcript reader parses only Claude Code Bash commands (src/discover/provider.rs:167-281); no Codex log reader exists in src/ or scripts/ (grep).

claims.claim: Tagline: 'High-performance CLI proxy that cuts up to 90% of the bash output your agent reads'.
'Single Rust binary, 100+ supported commands, <10ms overhead'; rtk filters and compresses command outputs before they reach the LLM context.

The 90% is bash-output reduction, 'not the same as cutting your bill by 90%': bash output is one contributor to input tokens and input tokens are only part of the bill, so the reduction dilutes at every step.
Reported token counts are estimated as bytes / 4; RTK ships no tokenizer, so percentages are reliable but absolute token numbers are approximate.
Hook-based agents rewrite Bash commands (git status -> rtk git status); the hook only runs on Bash tool calls, so Claude Code built-in Read/Grep/Glob are not rewritten.
'Does RTK break Claude's prompt cache? No.' Output is filtered once and stored in history; smaller outputs mean cheaper cache writes and reads.
The auto-rewrite hook gives '100% rtk adoption across all conversations and subagents, with no per-command context overhead' (Bash tool calls only).

Analytics commands listed: `rtk gain` (summary, graph, history, daily, JSON/CSV export), `rtk discover` (missed savings), `rtk session` (adoption). The README never mentions `rtk cc-economics` or ccusage.

When a command fails RTK saves the full unfiltered output so the LLM can recall it without re-executing ([full output: rtk recall <hash>]); [retriever] mode = sqlite (default) | tee | disabled; the sqlite store stays failure/truncation-driven.
RTK supports 18 AI coding tools; Claude Code via `rtk init -g` (PreToolUse hook, native binary) and Codex via `rtk init -g --codex` (PreToolUse hook with updatedInput + AGENTS.md).

Telemetry is disabled by default and needs explicit opt-in consent; `rtk telemetry status|enable|disable|forget`; `RTK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` blocks it regardless of consent; `forget` deletes 'all local data' and requests server-side erasure.
Linux and macOS are supported through the install script, Homebrew, cargo and pre-built tarballs; WSL 'behaves exactly like Linux'.
Name-collision warning: another project named rtk (Rust Type Kit) exists on crates.io; use `cargo install --git`.

install.command: download rtk-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz, rtk-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz, rtk-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz or rtk-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz from https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/releases and put rtk on PATH

platforms.linux_x86_64: yes - README.md:113 lists rtk-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz; install.sh:76 selects that target; .github/workflows/release.yml:47-50 builds it; ci.yml:60 runs cargo test on ubuntu-latest.
platforms.wsl2: yes (documented only, not CI-tested) - README.md:405-420 says WSL behaves exactly like Linux and shows the Linux install.sh run inside WSL; the ci.yml:60 matrix has no WSL job.
platforms.macos_arm64: yes - README.md:112 lists rtk-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz; release.yml:43-45 builds aarch64-apple-darwin on macos-latest; install.sh:43,80-82 maps arm64 to it; ci.yml:60 tests on macos-latest. Config/data dirs differ on macOS (README.md:453; src/core/tracking.rs:77-79).
platforms.gpu: no - not used or required; it is a text-filtering CLI, and `rtk smart` is heuristic only and ignores its model/force-download flags (src/cmds/system/local_llm.rs:1,10-11).

integrations.cli: yes - the `rtk` binary with dozens of clap subcommands (src/main.rs:92-972): per-tool filters (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, aws, ...), analytics (`gain`, `discover`, `session`, `learn`, `cc-economics`), recovery (`recall`), hook plumbing (`init`, `hook <agent>`, `rewrite`), `pipe` (stdin filter), `proxy`/`run` (raw), `telemetry`, `config`, `trust`, `verify`. Unknown commands fall back to a TOML filter or raw passthrough (src/main.rs:1545-1604). Exports: `rtk gain --format json|csv` (src/analytics/gain.rs:640-705) and `rtk cc-economics --format json|csv` (src/main.rs:521-523).
integrations.mcp: none found - no MCP server or subcommand; a repo-wide grep for MCP hits only a test string (src/hooks/init.rs:11683) and a filter fixture (src/filters/liquibase.toml:51).
integrations.sdk_or_api: none found - Cargo.toml defines no [lib] target and the code has no HTTP/socket server (ureq is only a client for telemetry; .semgrep.yml:29-46 forbids sockets and reqwest). Programmatic surfaces are the CLI JSON/CSV exports and the stdin/stdout JSON hook protocols (`rtk hook <agent>`, `rtk rewrite`; hooks/README.md:73-272).
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: Claude Code: `rtk init -g` writes ~/.claude/RTK.md, adds an @RTK.md line to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, and patches ~/.claude/settings.json (with .bak backup) with a PreToolUse hook, matcher 'Bash', running the native `rtk hook claude` (src/hooks/init.rs:1632-1659,1707-1756; src/hooks/constants.rs:12; README.md:372-380); only Bash tool calls are rewritten (README.md:153). The default awareness file is 8 lines (hooks/rtk-awareness.md:1-8); `--hook-only` skips it (README.md:376). Permission model is Deny > Ask > explicit Allow > default ask (src/hooks/README.md:69-84; src/hooks/decision.rs:38-97). Codex: `rtk init -g --codex` registers `rtk hook codex` as a PreToolUse hook in $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json (or .codex/hooks.json) and writes RTK.md plus an AGENTS.md reference (hooks/codex/README.md:7-16; src/hooks/constants.rs:17; src/hooks/init.rs:3053-3061); direct Codex rewriting is new in v0.50.0 (CHANGELOG.md:19-20) and Codex's safety classifier does not unwrap `rtk` (hooks/codex/README.md:14). Log-reading features (`discover`, `session`, `learn`, the RTK_DISABLED check in `gain`) read only Claude Code transcripts under ~/.claude/projects (src/discover/provider.rs:46-52,103-110; src/analytics/gain.rs:787-831); nothing reads Codex session logs.

readme.telemetry_and_network: Telemetry is compile-time gated and opt-in. TELEMETRY_URL comes from option_env!('RTK_TELEMETRY_URL'); with no URL built in, the ping code never runs (src/core/telemetry.rs:16-37). maybe_ping also requires RTK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED != 1, consent_given == Some(true), telemetry.enabled, and a 23-hour marker (telemetry.rs:33-78). Config defaults are enabled=false, consent=None (src/core/config.rs:209-216), and the consent prompt appears only on a TTY (src/hooks/init.rs:903-961; src/core/telemetry_cmd.rs:151-189). Official release builds inject the URL and token from CI vars/secrets (.github/workflows/release.yml:85-86,124-125,151-152), so release binaries can ping an RTK AI Labs endpoint after consent; `cargo install --git` builds have no endpoint unless built with the env var. Payload (telemetry.rs:117-156; docs/TELEMETRY.md:31-109): salted SHA-256 device hash, version/OS/arch/install method, command counts, top tool names (two-word labels), savings %, tokens saved, hook type, recall counters; no arguments or paths. The only ureq calls are that ping and the erasure POST of `rtk telemetry forget` (telemetry.rs:158-166; telemetry_cmd.rs:249-270). No account, API key or server is needed to run. Other network: install.sh downloads from github.com (install.sh:53-105); `rtk cc-economics` falls back to `npx --yes ccusage`, which fetches from the npm registry (src/analytics/ccusage.rs:104-119); wrapped tools (gh, curl, wget, aws, ...) do their own networking; the CI doc-review job calls api.anthropic.com with a CI secret (ci.yml:284-310; CI only). Docs conflict with code: DISCLAIMER.md:25 says metrics are collected 'by default', and docs/guide/getting-started/configuration.md:53-54,192-207 reads as opt-out; the code is opt-in. `telemetry forget` removes the salt, marker and history.db only, not recall.db (telemetry_cmd.rs:200-229), although README.md:519 says 'all local data'.

languages: Rust (primary: 131 .rs files in src/, 23 in tests/, build.rs)
TOML (63 built-in filter definitions in src/filters/*.toml)

entry_points.what: Binary `rtk` (Cargo.toml:2). fn main (:1859) -> run_cli (:1931): clap Cli/Commands enum (:92-972), telemetry ping, hook-outdated warning, integrity check, routing; run_fallback (:1545) handles unknown commands (TOML filter or raw passthrough).
`rtk hook <claude|codex|cursor|gemini|copilot|trae|droid|vibe|check>` PreToolUse processors: JSON on stdin, JSON on stdout (src/main.rs:974-1001).
`rtk rewrite '<cmd>'` used by the TypeScript/Python/shell plugin delegates; rules live in src/discover/registry.rs and src/discover/rules.rs (96 rules).
`rtk init` installers and uninstallers for the 18 agent integrations (settings.json / hooks.json patching, RTK.md, plugins).
`rtk cc-economics` (src/main.rs:507-524): joins RTK tracking data with ccusage output via src/analytics/ccusage.rs.
Linux/macOS installer: detects OS/arch, downloads release tarball and checksums.txt, verifies SHA-256, installs to ~/.local/bin.
Agent plugins that shell out to `rtk rewrite`: also hooks/pi/rtk.ts, hooks/hermes/rtk-rewrite/__init__.py, openclaw/index.ts.

code.architecture: Single Rust crate and binary (no [lib]; modules declared at src/main.rs:1-7). src/cmds/<ecosystem>/*_cmd.rs: per-tool Rust filters (git, cargo, js, python, go, jvm, php, ruby, dotnet, scala, cloud, system). src/filters/*.toml: 63 declarative filters merged and validated by build.rs into builtin_filters.toml, applied in run_fallback via src/core/toml_filter.rs; project/user filters need `rtk trust`. src/core/: runner.rs (shared exec skeleton, emit_guarded), stream.rs (child capture, RAW_CAP 10 MiB at :423), guard.rs (never_worse), tracking.rs (SQLite history.db with commands, parse_failures, hook_decisions; tokens = ceil(bytes/4); fixed 90-day cleanup), retriever.rs + tee.rs + tee_file.rs (recall.db content-addressed store, gzip, 12-hex SHA-256 id; legacy tee files), config.rs, telemetry.rs and telemetry_cmd.rs. src/hooks/: init.rs (installers), hook_cmd.rs (`rtk hook <agent>`), decision.rs + permissions.rs (Deny > Ask > explicit Allow > default ask), rewrite_cmd.rs, integrity.rs, trust.rs. src/discover/: lexer.rs, registry.rs + rules.rs (rewrite registry), provider.rs (ClaudeProvider reads ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl for Bash tool_use/tool_result: command, output length, error flag; no usage fields), report.rs; src/learn/ mines the same transcripts. src/analytics/: gain.rs (savings dashboard/export), session_cmd.rs, cc_economics.rs, ccusage.rs (subprocess to external `ccusage daily|weekly|monthly --json --since 20250101` or `npx --yes ccusage`; parses inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheCreationTokens, cacheReadTokens, totalTokens, totalCost). Measurement separation: `rtk gain` reports only estimated bash-output reduction; `rtk cc-economics` joins that with ccusage periods and derives dollar savings from hard-coded price ratios (output 5x, cache write 1.25x, cache read 0.1x; cc_economics.rs:17-21,113-137). Nothing in the repo parses `usage` blocks from Claude Code or Codex logs itself.
code.packaging_and_release: release-please (release-type rust) runs on master pushes and creates tags and changelog (.github/workflows/cd.yml:100-120; release-please-config.json). release.yml (reusable) builds `cargo build --release` for x86_64-apple-darwin, aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu (cross-linked) and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, packaging tar.gz/zip (release.yml:35-106), plus a DEB via cargo-deb and an RPM via cargo-generate-rpm (:108-161), copies rtk_amd64.deb and rtk.x86_64.rpm (:200-208), writes `checksums.txt` with `sha256sum *` (:210-213) and uploads via softprops/action-gh-release (:215-221). No signatures, SBOM or provenance attestations: a grep of .github for attest/cosign/sigstore/gpg/slsa finds nothing. Builds use floating `dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable` (:64-67) with the telemetry URL/token injected (:85-86). Homebrew formula is pushed to rtk-ai/homebrew-tap (:355-370); winget manifest via winget-releaser, continue-on-error (:372-404); pushes to develop produce `dev-<ver>-rc.<run>` pre-releases (cd.yml:21-94). There is no `cargo publish` step (crates.io not automated). In-repo Formula/rtk.rb is a placeholder (version 0.1.0, PLACEHOLDER sha256; Formula/rtk.rb:9-32). install.sh verifies SHA-256 against the same release's checksums.txt, rejects archives with absolute or .. paths, supports RTK_VERSION pinning, and can skip verification with RTK_SKIP_CHECKSUM=1 (install.sh:93-145). Most actions are pinned by tag, a few by SHA (next-release.yml:15, pr-target-check.yml:16,24, stale.yml:21, release.yml:398). Cargo.toml:71-85 holds the deb/rpm metadata.
code.tests_and_ci: Rust built-in test harness (`cargo test --all`); `temp-env` is the only test-specific dev-dependency (Cargo.toml:57-61). 106 of 131 src/*.rs files contain inline #[cfg(test)] modules (about 3,750 #[test] attributes); 23 integration test files in tests/*.rs (187 #[test]) with about 190 fixture files in tests/fixtures. The 63 built-in TOML filters carry 154 inline [[tests.*]] cases; a cargo test requires every built-in filter to have inline tests (src/core/toml_filter.rs:2166-2190) and `rtk verify` runs them (src/main.rs:760-768); no CI step invokes `rtk verify`. Hook-adapter tests (hooks/claude/test-rtk-rewrite.sh, hooks/copilot/test-rtk-rewrite.sh, hooks/hermes/tests/test_rtk_rewrite_plugin.py) and scripts/test-all.sh are not run by any workflow (grep of .github). Unit tests assert savings thresholds with a whitespace-word count (src/core/utils.rs:374-376), unlike the runtime bytes/4 estimate. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs only on pull_request to develop/master: test-presence gate (scripts/check-test-presence.sh), `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets`, `cargo test --all` on ubuntu/windows/macos (:53-67), a security job (cargo audit that only warns, critical-file/dangerous-pattern/new-dependency greps, clippy unwrap/panic lints; :69-188), semgrep with .semgrep.yml and --baseline-commit (:190-200), `scripts/benchmark.sh` (fails if a filter emits more tokens than raw or empty output; only warns below 60% 'good'; scripts/benchmark.sh:866-882), and an AI doc-review job on develop PRs that calls the Anthropic API (:235-391). Other workflows: cd.yml, release.yml (builds without running tests), next-release.yml, pr-target-check.yml, stale.yml; Dependabot weekly for cargo and github-actions (.github/dependabot.yml). .github/workflows/CICD.md:25 describes the benchmark gate as '>=80% savings', which the script does not enforce.
code.dependencies: Cargo.toml: 23 direct [dependencies] (clap, anyhow, encoding_rs, codepage, oem_cp, ignore, walkdir, regex, serde, serde_json, colored, dirs, rusqlite[bundled], toml, toml_edit, chrono, tempfile, sha2, ureq, getrandom, flate2, quick-xml, which) plus 1 unix-only (libc), 1 windows-only (windows-sys), 1 build (toml) and 1 dev (temp-env) = 27 direct entries; Cargo.lock lists 213 packages including rtk itself. rust-version 1.91, edition 2024; rusqlite 'bundled' compiles SQLite from C source. ureq is the only HTTP client (telemetry only). openclaw/package.json declares no dependencies; there are no other Node or Python manifests. Optional runtime tools: ccusage (npm), rg, and whatever CLIs are wrapped.
code.security_policy: SECURITY.md at repo root: report privately to security@rtk-ai.app or via a GitHub private advisory, 48-hour acknowledgement target, 90-day embargo (SECURITY.md:3-9). It is partly stale: it cites .github/workflows/security-check.yml, src/runner.rs, src/summary.rs, src/tracking.rs, src/pnpm_cmd.rs, src/container.rs, hooks/rtk-rewrite.sh and scripts/detect-dangerous-patterns.sh, none of which exist at this tag (SECURITY.md:30,51-59,92), and says 'Last updated: 2026-03-05' (:217). Actual checks run in ci.yml (security job, semgrep) and .semgrep.yml. Cargo.toml sets `unsafe_code = deny` and `warnings = deny` (:87-89), with 10 localized #[allow(unsafe_code)] sites (src/main.rs:1865,3055; src/core/stream.rs:286-399; src/core/utils.rs:873; src/core/tee_file.rs:324).

claim_checks.claim: Token counts are bytes/4 estimates, percentages are reliable and absolute numbers approximate (README.md:72).
claim_checks.evidence: estimate_tokens_from_len is ceil(len/4) (src/core/tracking.rs:1788-1797), applied identically to raw and filtered text in TimedExecution::track (:1866-1879); record stores signed saved/pct (:602-643); `rtk gain --format json` exports only these estimates (src/analytics/gain.rs:651-660); Cargo.toml has no tokenizer dependency.

claim_checks.claim: README reports only bash-output reduction, 'not the same as cutting your bill' (README.md:68-74); it documents no provider-usage measurement, and the provider-usage path is `rtk cc-economics`.
claim_checks.evidence: `gain` never reads provider usage (src/analytics/gain.rs; src/core/tracking.rs). Provider token breakdown appears only in `rtk cc-economics` (src/analytics/cc_economics.rs:427-467), which shells out to external ccusage (src/analytics/ccusage.rs:93-170) and is labelled Claude Code economics (src/main.rs:507); fields parsed are inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheCreationTokens, cacheReadTokens (both default 0), totalTokens, totalCost (ccusage.rs:16-30). docs/guide/resources/troubleshooting.md:176-182 points to cc-economics for cache volumes; the README never mentions it. No Codex usage reader: Codex appears in src/ only in hook/installer code, src/hooks/constants.rs:35 and telemetry hook detection (src/core/telemetry.rs:478). RTK's own JSONL reader keeps only Bash commands, output length and error flag (src/discover/provider.rs:167-281). What logs ccusage itself reads is not shown in this repo.

claim_checks.claim: On failure RTK saves the full unfiltered output so the LLM can recall it without re-executing (README.md:464-471).
claim_checks.evidence: Holds for non-zero exits with at least 500 bytes of raw output (src/core/tee.rs:52-67; src/core/retriever.rs:18) and for filters that call force_tee_hint/force_tee_tail_hint (81 occurrences across 28 files under src/). Sqlite mode never stores ordinary successful runs (tee.rs:53-55; test at :130-143). Defaults: 200 entries, 30 days, 10 MiB per entry, gzip (retriever.rs:15-17); over the cap only the hidden tail is kept (retriever.rs:499-512). Disabled by RTK_RECALL=0 or RTK_TEE=0 (retriever.rs:424-427). So recoverability is conditional, not universal.

claim_checks.claim: 'Does RTK break Claude's prompt cache? No' (README.md:173).
claim_checks.evidence: Provider-side caching behaviour cannot be checked from this repo. The code only shows the rewrite happens before execution and output is produced once (hooks/README.md:24-37). `rtk cc-economics` can show cache write/read volumes (cc_economics.rs:459-466; docs/guide/resources/troubleshooting.md:167-182). The project's own paired run shows cache read 281,580 (OFF) vs 275,317 (ON) with unchanged cost (FIX_PERF.md:14-19); no cache-specific test was found.

claim_checks.claim: Auto-rewrite hook gives '100% rtk adoption across all conversations and subagents' (README.md:364-368).
claim_checks.evidence: The README itself limits scope to Bash tool calls (README.md:153,368). Only the final stage of a pipeline is rewritten (hooks/README.md:289-298; src/discover/registry.rs:665-669); substitutions and heredocs defer (src/hooks/decision.rs:86-88). The project's own 2026-07-20 benchmark measured 57% hook coverage vs ~100% expected (FIX_PERF.md:22), before pipeline fixes in 0.44.0 and 0.49.0 (CHANGELOG.md:475-476,90,128); no post-fix coverage number is stored in the repo.

claim_checks.claim: Telemetry is disabled by default and requires explicit opt-in consent (README.md:493).
claim_checks.evidence: Code is opt-in: TelemetryConfig derives Default, so enabled=false and consent=None (src/core/config.rs:209-216); maybe_ping returns unless consent_given == Some(true) and enabled (src/core/telemetry.rs:50-59); the prompt only runs on a TTY (src/hooks/init.rs:903-925). Caveats: release builds embed the endpoint (release.yml:85-86); DISCLAIMER.md:25 says 'by default' and docs/guide/getting-started/configuration.md:53-54,192-207 reads as opt-out (docs are wrong, code wins); `forget` does not delete recall.db (src/core/telemetry_cmd.rs:200-229).

CONTRIBUTING.md:59-63 sets <10ms as a goal; CI has no latency measurement (scripts/benchmark.sh counts tokens only). docs/contributing/ARCHITECTURE.md:34,1014 say ~5-15ms and its tables show +8 to +20ms (:537-546), with the runtime table labelled estimates (:992). Every wrapped command also opens SQLite and writes a row (src/core/tracking.rs:323-325,1866-1879).
96 rewrite rules in src/discover/rules.rs, 63 built-in TOML filters in src/filters/ (build.rs:17-67), plus the Rust filter modules under src/cmds/ and the Commands enum (src/main.rs:92-972).

claim_checks.claim: Claude Code uses a PreToolUse hook (native binary) and Codex a PreToolUse hook with updatedInput + AGENTS.md (README.md:428,433).
claim_checks.evidence: Code wins over stale docs. constants define `rtk hook claude` and `rtk hook codex` (src/hooks/constants.rs:12,17); init writes the Claude entry with matcher Bash (src/hooks/init.rs:1632-1659,1754-1756) and patches Codex hooks.json (init.rs:3061,3141); HookCommands::Codex exists (src/main.rs:980-981). Stale statements: hooks/claude/README.md:7 (shell hook requiring jq) and docs/guide/getting-started/configuration.md:84 (lists Codex among hook-less agents, while init.rs:3056 honours the configured awareness level). Codex rewriting is new in v0.50.0 (CHANGELOG.md:19-20).

claim_checks.claim: (Docs, not README) `[tracking] enabled` and `history_days` are configurable (docs/guide/getting-started/configuration.md:25-28; docs/TELEMETRY.md:141).
claim_checks.evidence: Both fields are defined and defaulted (src/core/config.rs:153-168) but never read anywhere in src/. Retention uses the constant DEFAULT_HISTORY_DAYS = 90 (src/core/constants.rs:7; src/core/tracking.rs:645-660) and TimedExecution::track records unconditionally (tracking.rs:1866-1879).

risks: Provider-usage measurement is not self-contained and is Claude-only: it needs the external ccusage npm CLI on PATH or via `npx --yes ccusage`, which downloads from npm at runtime (src/analytics/ccusage.rs:93-122); no Codex usage reader exists in src/ or scripts/. The ccusage window is hard-coded `--since 20250101` while comments say 'last 90 days' (ccusage.rs:124,144-147), and cc-economics compares RTK savings (history.db keeps at most 90 days, tracking.rs:645-660) against ccusage cost since 2025 (cc_economics.rs:312-396,479-484); price ratios are hard-coded 'verified Feb 2026' (cc_economics.rs:17-21).

Savings figures are estimates and counterfactual (bytes/4, no tokenizer; tracking.rs:1788-1797). The project's own FIX_PERF.md reports no cost saving in a paired run (0.4604 vs 0.4614 USD; 17.4 -> 20.8 commands; 0 vs 5 errors) and says `rtk gain` credits full raw bytes even where the harness would truncate anyway (FIX_PERF.md:14-24,262-264). The harness it cites is not in this checkout (scripts/benchmark-sessions contains only lib/runner.py), so results cannot be re-run here, and no independent or post-fix benchmark is stored in the repo.

Originals are recoverable only conditionally: sqlite mode stores only non-zero-exit outputs of at least 500 bytes or filter-specific truncations (src/core/tee.rs:52-67; retriever.rs:18); defaults are 200 entries, 30 days, 10 MiB per entry, and over-cap entries keep only the hidden tail (retriever.rs:15-17,499-512). The store holds raw failing output (possible secrets) on disk, and `rtk telemetry forget` removes history.db but not recall.db (telemetry_cmd.rs:200-229).

Rewrite-correctness and coverage risk: the project documents that format-changing filters can break downstream consumers (`rtk find | xargs wc -l` failed 10/10; `cargo clippy | tee | grep` silently counted 0 warnings; FIX_PERF.md:48-122). v0.50.0 rewrites only a safe final pipeline stage (hooks/README.md:289-298) following fixes in 0.44.0/0.49.0 (CHANGELOG.md:475-476,90,128), but this was not re-benchmarked. `rtk pipe` bails and discards stdin over 10 MiB (src/cmds/system/pipe_cmd.rs:268-269; stream.rs:423); Claude built-in Read/Grep/Glob bypass the hook (README.md:153); Codex hook support is new in v0.50.0 and its classifier does not unwrap `rtk` (CHANGELOG.md:19-20; hooks/codex/README.md:14); sandboxed Codex may block history writes (hooks/codex/README.md:26-38).

Telemetry: official release binaries are built with the endpoint and token injected (release.yml:85-86,124-125,151-152). The code is opt-in (src/core/config.rs:209-216; telemetry.rs:50-59), but DISCLAIMER.md:25 says metrics are collected 'by default' and the configuration guide shows `enabled = true` with opt-out wording (docs/guide/getting-started/configuration.md:53-54,192-207), so project documents contradict each other.

Supply chain and packaging: release assets carry only a same-release checksums.txt (release.yml:210-213), with no signatures, SBOM or attestations; install.sh can skip verification with RTK_SKIP_CHECKSUM=1 (install.sh:105-110); builds use floating stable Rust. crates.io `rtk` is a different project (README.md:125) and no `cargo publish` exists; in-repo Formula/rtk.rb is a placeholder (Formula/rtk.rb:9-32) and brew instructions differ (README.md:80-82 vs docs/guide/getting-started/installation.md:37). `cargo audit` in CI only warns (ci.yml:85-99); `warnings = deny` (Cargo.toml:87-89) can fail source builds on newer toolchains.

Documentation drift: SECURITY.md cites 8 non-existent paths and was last updated 2026-03-05 (SECURITY.md:30,51-59,92,217); the README CI badge targets a 'Security Check' workflow that does not exist (README.md:10; workflow names are CI, CD, Release, ...); README says `rtk --version` shows 0.28.2 (README.md:121) vs 0.50.0 (Cargo.toml:3); docs name the tracking DB tracking.db (tracking.rs:9,77) but the code uses history.db (constants.rs:2); hooks/claude/README.md:7 describes a jq shell hook while the code installs native `rtk hook claude`; `tracking.history_days` and `tracking.enabled` are inert (config.rs:153-168).

Maintenance and scope: pre-1.0 with five minor releases between 2026-08-26 and 2026-09-24 (CHANGELOG.md:8,78,145,190,284); large surface (131 src files, 96 rewrite rules, 63 TOML filters, 18 agent integrations); a SQLite open+write on every wrapped command (tracking.rs:323-325,1866-1879); `unsafe` is lint-denied yet allowed in 10 places (src/main.rs, src/core/stream.rs, src/core/utils.rs, src/core/tee_file.rs).
